definitions.gloss: to sharpen, to grind, to whet
definitions.explanation: To make a blade sharp by rubbing against a stone or other abrasive.
To wash rice by rubbing it in water before cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぐ。
⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}いで⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Wash the rice before putting it in the rice cooker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぐ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a craftsman sharpening a sword.

examples.japanese: ⟦はさみ→はさみ：00702_hasami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}いだ。
⟦{切|き}れなく→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}いで⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my dull knife sharpened.
I washed the rice three times.

examples.japanese: ⟦ごはん→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}がなければ⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: You have to wash the rice before cooking it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研|と}ぎ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: My mother taught me how to wash rice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}がなくて⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Recently I use no-wash rice, so I don't have to wash it.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). No common pair. Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぐ (to sharpen/wash X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {研|と}いでいる = 'is sharpening/washing.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぐ (to sharpen a knife)
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぐ (to wash rice)
- ⟦{砥石|といし}→砥石：06525_toishi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{研|と}ぐ (to sharpen with a whetstone)

RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{砥石|といし}→砥石：06525_toishi⟧ - whetstone
- {研|と}ぎ⟦{器|き}→器：noentry⟧ - sharpener
- ⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧ - no-wash rice

NOTE: The rice-washing meaning (⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{研|と}ぐ) is very common in everyday Japanese. Modern rice cookers often use ⟦{無洗米|むせんまい}→無洗米：28489_musenmai⟧ that doesn't need washing.
